scope: Accept unchanged scratch candidate for coordinator adoption review. No production adoption or packaged acceptance performed.
reasoning: Header bytes always copied. A complete header with no body leaves headerBytes=4; empty push does nothing and finish reports truncation. Next nonempty push reads the same header, including size=0 header-copy behavior. Zero and oversized lengths throw before the new branch.

Only complete unshared bodies use a local subarray, synchronously decoded by a new fatal UTF-8 TextDecoder and JSON.parse. Offset arithmetic advances once per accepted body; coalesced and partial following frames retain original behavior. Fragmented bodies and all real shared-backed input keep the original owned copy path.

On UTF-8 or JSON failure, the direct path copies the body before throwing the same error object. Follow-up empty input returns []; nonempty input decodes the full poisoned body again without consuming new input; finish always reports truncation. Input mutation after return cannot repair the poison.

Node stdin calls push synchronously with ordinary Buffer input; no await, reviver or user callback occurs between creating the body view and completing normal decode/parse. Caller mutation cannot interleave on an unshared ArrayBuffer. Shared inputs intentionally bypass the direct path.

BOM handling, scalar values, fatal UTF-8, exact constructor/name/message/code, negative zero, escaped lone surrogates, normal Uint8Array subclasses, cross-realm/shared/offset views, resizable backing, detached empty views and maximum lengths were checked without narrowing accepted real input types.

UTF-8/JSON internals may allocate independently. Logical counts show removed explicit allocations/copies for complete unshared successes only. GC weak references establish caller backing release, not whole-process physical memory savings.

rootSuiteCaveat: 370 combined tests passed per coordinator evidence; not independently rerun here. Entry imports redirect to candidate, but explicit subprocesses without forwarded --import may load production. Do not describe every helper as candidate-tested.

objections.issue: A custom Uint8Array subclass overriding subarray to return Uint16Array decodes differently: original copies element values into bytes and returns null; candidate decodes the raw 16-bit representation and throws SyntaxError.
objections.repro: Pinned Node --expose-gc build/efficiency-20261103/native-complete-frame-review/error-gc.mjs; see error-gc.json subtype rows.
objections.disposition: Synthetic overridden-method contract difference, not normal stdin reachability. Plain subclasses pass. Do not generalize this exclusion to cross-realm, offset, resizable, Buffer or shared Uint8Array inputs.

objections.issue: OOM or monkeypatched allocation/parse/subarray failure can change exception timing or poison state. Catch also includes messages.push.
objections.disposition: No ordinary-input failure demonstrated. Builtins do not invoke caller callbacks here. No claim of OOM or patched-intrinsic equivalence.

objections.issue: Two original passes are warmed same-runtime synthetic loops with fixed reused inputs. They measure process CPU rather than isolated decoder CPU. No affinity, confidence interval or cold/error throughput coverage.
objections.disposition: Gate recomputed exactly with all measured samples; all seven workloads pass. A pair above 1.10 is not a median gate breach. Additional fresh varied-input sample retained without discarding large outliers.

objections.issue: Initial GC fixture could lose earlier decoders; old execFileSync runners lacked whole-group timeout cleanup.
objections.disposition: Transparent failed trial retained. Corrected fixture holds all eight decoders; this reviewer reproduced it. Owned review supervisor cleans only its detached child group on exit or timeout; no forbidden existing runner executed.

benchmarkGate.gate: Reject if any workload median paired CPU candidate/original exceeds 1.05 in both initial and independent repeat, or any repeat exceeds 1.10. Require differential and GC parity. Allocation reduction alone is insufficient.
benchmarkGate.repeat: Always run a second full pass, retain all samples including warmups.
benchmarkGate.scope: Full frozen modules; one live decoder reused per sample; owned synthetic memory only. CPU process.cpuUsage and wall performance.now; no instrumentation. Byte sizes are UTF-8 body sizes. Alternating order each pair.

independentTiming.limitations: One bounded pass, 8 measured pairs after 3 warmups per workload; freshly generated varied corpus each pair, equivalent separate backing per variant, alternating order, full frozen modules. Several very short pairs have large outliers. No precise speedup or regression-rate claim from this sample.

openAcceptance: Real native stdio and packaged transport
Node 22 and other supported runtimes; Windows/Linux
Cold-start, malformed/shared throughput, actual transport chunk distribution
Concurrent shared writer stress; unchanged shared-copy path alone does not promise atomic snapshots
reproduction: From repository root: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B build/efficiency-20261103/native-complete-frame-review/run.py. Then run-extra.py for fatal UTF-8 GC and synthetic subclass checks. Each child has its own process group and a 10-50 second timeout. NODE_OPTIONS is cleared for children. Offline, decoder-only imports.
